f2173ebf-7bcf-46fb-817e-b726870c0c66.value:
=== CITUS DISTRIBUTION LEGEND ===

Green (#c8e6c9): Distributed by iq_tenant_id
  All tenant-scoped queries are shard-local.
  JOINs within a tenant hit one node.

Yellow (#fff9c4): Reference table
  Replicated to ALL worker nodes.
  JOINs from any distributed table are local.
  Used for small, read-heavy, globally-shared data.

No blue tables in Configurator — all tables are
either reference (platform data) or distributed
(tenant config). No special-distribution tables.
